verses.text: Ix yalan Jesús t'ayin: Tz'ib'ejb'at t'a in chekab' ayek' t'a skal heb' creyente t'a chonhab' Éfeso icha tik. Ha jun yamjinakk'e uke' k'anal t'a swach' k'ab', haton jun sb'eyek' t'a skal uke' sb'akhnub' candil nab'a oro, a tz'alan t'ayex:

Wojtak masanil tas tze k'ulej. Wojtak to tzeyak' wal och t'a he k'ol he munlaj t'a yik Dios, te niwan pax tzeyutej he k'ol eyak'an techajok, max he chapaxoch heb' manh wach'ok t'a he kal. Wojtak paxi to ix laj eyak' prowal heb' syaloch sb'a in chekab'ok. Ix ilchajelta eyu'uj to yes heb'.
Wu'ujnhej te niwan yahelal sjawi t'a eyib'anh, palta tzeyak' techajok, max eyak'paxlaj chab'ax he k'o'ol.
Palta ay wal syal janik' in k'o'ol t'ayex, yujto maxtzak in he xajanej icha t'a sb'ab'elal.

Yuj chi' naekkoti, chajtil eyaji ayik manto chab'ax he k'o'ol. Naek he b'a, b'oekxi he b'a icha t'a yalanhtaxo. Tato max he na he b'a, elanhchamel ol in jawok t'ayex, ol wik'anel sb'akhnub' he candil t'a yet'tal.
Palta ay jun wach' tze k'ulej swila', yujto a sb'eyb'al heb' nicolaíta tze chakeli, icha swutej in chakanpaxel a in tik.

Masanil mach tz'ab'ani, yak'okab'och schikin t'a tas syal Espíritu t'a junjun iglesia. Ha heb' ol ak'an techajok, ol wak' sat jun te te' yik k 'inal t'a junelnhej slo heb'. Ha jun te te' chi', ha t'a swach'ilal Dios ayek' te', xchi Jesús t'ayin.

Ix yalanxi Jesús t'ayin: Tz'ib'ejb'at t'a in chekab' ayek' t'a skal heb' creyente t'a chonhab' Esmirna icha tik: Ha jun mach b'ab'el t'a yichanh smasanil, slajwub' paxi, haton jun chamnak, palta pitzwinakxi, a tz'alan t'ayex icha tik:

Wojtak jantak syahelal sjawi t'a eyib'anh. Te meb'a' ex, palta wal yel te b'eyum ex. Wojtak paxi chajtil tz'aj he b'uchji yuj heb' syaloch sb'a israelal, palta a smolanil heb' chi' yik winh Satanás yaji.

Manh ex xiw yuj juntzanh yahelal ol jawok t'a eyib'anh. Yujto ayex ol ex ak'jok och t'a preso yuj winh diablo yuj eyak'ji prowal. Lajunhe' k'u ol ex och t'a syahelal. Palta k'anab'ajumnhej tzeyutej he b'a masanto t'a chamel. Tato icha chi' tzeyutej he b'a, ol wak' spak t'ayex, haton he k 'inal t'a junelnhej.
Masanil mach tz'ab'ani, yak'okab' och schikin t'a tas syal Espíritu t'a junjun iglesia. Ha heb' ol ak'an techajok, manhxo ol yab'laj sya'il heb' t'a junxo schab'il chamel, xchi Jesús t'ayin.
Ix yalanpax Jesús t'ayin: Tz'ib'ejb'at t'a in chekab' ayek' t'a skal heb' creyente t'a Pérgamo icha tik: Ha jun ay yespada te jay ye t'a schab'il pak'anh, a tz'alan t'ayex:

Wojtak b'ajtil ayex ek'i. Ay ex ek' t'a jun chonhab' b'aj syak' yajalil winh Satanás, palta hanheja' tzin he k'anab'ajej. Ha winhaj Antipas, yak'nak wal testigo'al sb'a winh wu'uj. Milb'ilcham winh t'a he kal b'aj ayek' winh Satanás chi', palta hanheja' tek'an ix eyutej he b'a t'ayin.

Palta ayto juntzanh he palta'il swila', yujto ayex tzato eyak'och he chikin t'a sk'ayb'ub'al winhaj Balaam. Ha winh ak'jinak sk'o'ol winhaj Balac ayik yak'annak juwokel heb' israel winh. Yuj winhaj Balac chi', schinak juntzanh nok' heb', juntzanh nok' tz'ak'ji t'a skomon diosal heb'. Emnak pax heb' ajmulal.
Hanheja' ayex pax tzeyak'och he pensar t'a sk'ayb'ub'al heb' nicolaíta.
Yuj chi', naek he b'a tikne'ik, tato ma'ay, elanhchamel ol in jawok t'ayex, ol wak'an owal yet' heb' icha chi' sk'ulej. Ha jun espada ayelta t'a yol in ti', a ol wak'lab'ej.

Masanil mach tz'ab'ani, yak'okab' och schikin t'a tas syal Espíritu t'a junjun iglesia. Ha heb' ol ak'an techajok, ol wak' jun maná swa heb', haton jun k'ub'aneli. Ol wak'anpax junjunok k'e'en k'e'en saksak t'a heb'. Ha t'a jun k'e'en chi' tz'ib'ab'iloch jun ak' b'i malaj mach ojtannak. Ha heb' ol cha'an yiko', anhej heb' ol ojtakanelok, xchi Jesús t'ayin.

Ix yalanxi Jesús t'ayin: Icha tik tzutej a tz'ib'anb'at t'a in chekab' ayek' t'a skal heb' creyente t'a chonhab' Tiatira: Ha Yuninal Dios icha k'ak' yol sat, haxo yok toxonhej swe'ei icha k'e'en bronce, a tz'alan jun tik t'ayex:

Wojtak masanil tas tze k'ulej. Tzin he xajanej. Tzin eyak'anoch t'a he k'o'ol. Tzin eyak'anpax serwil. Tek'an wal tzeyutej he b'a eyak'an techajok. Wojtak to ek'alto tzex munlaj tikne'ik icha t'a yalanhtaxo.

Palta ay janik' tas tzin na t'a he patik, yujto tze chaoch ix Jezabel t'a he kal. Ha jun ix chi', syaloch sb'a ix schekab'ok Dios, palta tonhej syak' musansatil heb' in chekab' ix. Yujto a ix tz'ak'an sk'o'ol heb' yik tz'em heb' ajmulal, skuchb'an pax heb' ix schi juntzanh nok' nok' tz'ak'ji silab'il t'a juntzanh komon Dios.
Niwan ix wutej in k'o'ol t'a ix, talaj sna sb'a ix yuj jun yajmulal chi', palta malaj snib'ej ix sna sb'a t'a smul chi'.

Yuj chi' ol wak'och syahelal ix, ol b'atkan ix t'a sat ch'at. Yet' pax heb' sk'ulan ajmulal chi' yet' ix, tato manh ol sna sb'a heb', tato max yaktejkan heb' sk'ulan icha sk'ulej ix chi', ol wak'pax wal och syahelal heb'.

Hanhejtona' ol wak'pax miljokcham heb' yune' ix. Icha chi' ol aj in yojtakanel heb' creyente t'a junjun iglesia to a in tik wojtak masanil tas ay t'a spensar heb' yet' tastak sna heb'. Ol yojtakejpaxel heb' to a in tik ol wak' spak t'ayex junjun ex hato syala' tas tze k'ulej.

Palta a exxo aj Tiatira ex chi', a ex ton max eyak'och he pensar t'a sk'ayb'ub'al jun ix chi', haton juntzanh k'ayb'ub'al syal heb' to yik winh Satanás yaji, manh komonok tz'ojtakajeli. Palta a exxo max eyak'och he b'a yet' heb', anhej jun tik swalb'at t'ayex: Wach'nhej tzeyutej he b'a masanto ol in jaxok, manhxa junokxo cheknab'il syal walanb'at t'ayex.
Ha heb' ol ak'an techaj sk'ulan icha in gana masanto t'a slajwub', haton heb' ol wak'och yopisio yak'an yajalil t'a juntzanh nación.

Icha yutejnak in Mam yak'an wopisio, icha chi' ol wutok wak'an yopisio heb'. Yuj chi' ol yak' yajalil heb', manhxo ol ok'laj sk'o'ol heb'. Ol satel juntzanh niwak nación chi' heb', icha tz'aj smak'jipoj junok lum chen yet' junok k'e'en k'okoch.
Hanhejtona' ol wak'pax jun k'e'en nit k'anal t'a heb'.
Masanil mach tz'ab'ani, yak'okab' och schikin t'a tas syal Espíritu t'a junjun iglesia, xchi Jesús t'ayin.
